finding.headline: "The School Run With a Newborn"
finding.problem: "I'm packing a uniform with one hand and a breast pump with the other. We're late again. The class teacher side-eyes me."
finding.person: Mum who must get her 6-year-old to school by 8am with a 3-week-old who fusses; late every morning, judged by other mums.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (school-run + newborn routine)". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
